title: Soft Body Sculptor Studio
description: The user enters a sculpting studio where Michelle stands on a platform surrounded by floating ShaderBall2 objects that behave as soft, deformable bodies. The user must guide Michelle through a sequence of interactions: poking, stretching, inflating, deflating, and reshaping the soft shader balls by clicking control points, adjusting sliders, and dragging vertices, ultimately molding them into a target silhouette displayed as a ghost outline.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load Michelle.glb centered on a circular platform at origin and load 4 instances of ShaderBall2.glb arranged in a semicircle (radius 3 units) around her at equal angular intervals. Implement a soft-body simulation on each ShaderBall2 mesh: extract geometry vertices into a spring-mass particle system where each vertex is a mass point connected to neighbors by damped springs (stiffness 0.4, damping 0.02). Add gravity (0.5 downward) and floor collision at the platform height. The interaction sequence requires 8 steps with parameter validation: (1) Click a shader ball to select it — highlight with emissive glow. (2) Use a 'Poke' button that applies an inward force impulse at the clicked surface point, deforming the mesh inward by at least 15% of its radius. (3) Drag on the ball surface to stretch vertices outward — validate displacement exceeds 0.3 units. (4) Use an 'Inflate' slider (0-2) to apply outward pressure to all particles — validate slider reaches above 1.5. (5) Use a 'Deflate' button to reduce volume by 40%. (6) Click Michelle to trigger a wave animation where she raises her arm and a radial force pulse emanates from her hand, pushing all soft balls outward. (7) Use a 'Stiffness' slider (0.1-1.0) to change spring constants in real-time — validate value is set below 0.25 to make balls visibly droopy. (8) Press 'Reset Shape' to restore original geometry with a smooth 2-second lerp animation. Camera: perspective at (0, 3, 7) looking at origin. Lighting: warm directional light from upper-left, soft ambient, and a subtle rim light behind Michelle. Add an HTML overlay panel on the right with all buttons and sliders. Display a step counter showing current step out of 8. Each step unlocks only after the previous is validated. Use a pastel studio background color (#f0e6d3).
